glossdef.p: If the CPU is your system’s brain, then the RAM is how many thoughts your system can hold on to at one time. A very fast CPU will need a large amount of RAM to meet its full potential.

RAM is categorized by the basic technology and clock speed, e.g. DDR4-3200. Higher numbers are better for both cases; DDR5 RAM is better than DDR4, and a 3200 clock speed is better than 2133. Most RAM can be overclocked for better performance. Make sure your RAM is compatible with your motherboard.
